capabilities: Convert selected CSV text into a Markdown table via a command palette command
Detect the separator (comma or semicolon) from the first line
Warn and abort when a selection mixes both separators
disambiguation: Not a table editor; it only converts an existing text selection once, via a single command.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README explains the separator ambiguity behavior and lists three similar plugins it was inspired by.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to convert selected CSV text into a Markdown table.

relations.evidence: kepano's List to table — works on lists, not comma-separated text
full visual table editor with CSV import among many features, unmaintained for a few years
converts pasted CSV/Excel data on paste, but doesn't offer a standalone command

summary: Command-based converter that turns a selection of comma- or semicolon-separated text into a Markdown table.
